system.name: Charon
system.one_liner: a unified, operator-level simulator that predicts LLM training and inference performance so configurations can be explored without cluster profiling

components.name: Native Models
components.role: input: Hugging Face / PyTorch / vLLM models, drawn as their logos

components.name: GPU cluster
components.role: stacked GPU-card icons standing for running the training / inference workload on real hardware

components.name: Workload outcome
components.role: bullet list: Best Config, Expected Perf, Exec Timeline

components.name: Charon Simulation Platform
components.role: grey rounded platform card holding the three capabilities

components.name: Cost Per Evaluation

flows.what: profiling-based tuning (red label): the expensive old way
the same outputs, obtained by simulation

content.key_idea: Charon replaces profiling-based tuning on a GPU cluster with operator-level simulation that gives the same outputs at a 30,000x lower cost and a 3.74% error.
content.reading_order: Top-left logos -> red 'Profiling-based Tuning' arrow to GPU stacks and outcomes, OR down into the grey Charon platform and back up through the green 'Design Exploration w/ Charon' label; then the two cards on the right: cost, then accuracy.

palette.used_for: Profile bar in the accuracy chart
Charon bar in the accuracy chart
text: the old way and its cost ($1k, Profile, Profiling-based Tuning)
text: Charon and its result (Few cents, -3.74%, Design Exploration w/ Charon)

style.stroke: dark ink (#042433) ~0.65 pt outline on every box; black 1.3 pt frames around the two result cards
style.font: Calibri Bold throughout (Aptos Bold for titles), 6-7 pt at print size
style.arrows: short thick straight black arrows with solid heads
style.icons: Hugging Face, PyTorch and vLLM logos; GPU-card stacks; money and coin glyphs

encoding.color_means: red = profiling / the expensive baseline, green = Charon / the result; the three pastel bars are one colour per capability and reappear in the later figures (pink graph, blue compute, mint communication)
encoding.line_style_means: all lines solid; arrows only for the two alternative routes
encoding.emphasis: coloured bold text for the two competing routes and for the headline numbers; a black frame singles out each result card
reusable_patterns: teaser split: system-as-platform-card on the left, two framed one-number result cards on the right
old-way vs our-way arrows into the same outputs, labelled in red and green text instead of being drawn twice
capability list as full-width pastel bars inside a grey platform card
weaknesses: at print size (221 pt wide) the capability bars and card titles print at about 6 pt; the bitmap logos are the only non-text identity cue for the input

evidence: enables end-to-end, operator-level simulation for LLM training and inference
more than 30k cost reduction compared with cluster profiling

summary: The teaser contrasts two ways to find a good training or inference configuration for a native model: profiling-based tuning on a real GPU cluster (red route, $1k per evaluation) and design exploration with the Charon simulation platform (green route, a few cents). The platform is a grey rounded card listing three capabilities as full-width pastel bars; two framed cards on the right state the cost saving (>30k x) and the accuracy (-3.74% versus profiling).
summary_zh: 引言配图：左边是同一个模型的两条调参路线，红色是上集群实测（每次约 1000 美元），绿色是用 Charon 仿真；Charon 画成灰色圆角平台卡，里面三条通栏浅色条列出三项能力。右边两张黑框小卡分别给出成本（省 3 万倍以上）和精度（误差 3.74%）。
notes: Style reference for the named style 'charon' (references/styles/charon.md); not a rated corpus figure.
